An '''operations center''' served the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was separate from the SIS headquarters at the [[Heorem Complex]]. The operations center also had a parking garage for [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]].
